title: Smallest String With A Given Numeric Value
description: Construct a string of length n with a total numeric value k, where 'a'=1, 'b'=2, ..., 'z'=26. Use the lexicographically smallest string possible.
pseudocode:
1. result = array of 'a' filled n times
2. k = k - n
3. i = n - 1
4. while k > 0:
5.   add = min(k, 25)
6.   result[i] += add
7.   k -= add
8.   i -= 1

steps.note: Initialize result array of length 3 with 'a' (value 1)
Decrement i to 1. Loop terminates as k is 0.
